faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.description: Everything you might want to know before we start working together.

items.q: Do you work with businesses in all industries?
items.a: Yes. We have delivered for education, healthcare, logistics, legal, fintech and manufacturing clients. Every engagement starts with discovery so we understand your industry before we design anything.

items.q: How long does it take to see results?
items.a: It depends on scope. Digital marketing efforts often show improvement within a few months, while larger builds such as custom software or brand development follow a phased roadmap with milestones you can track.

items.q: What metrics do you use to measure success?
items.a: We agree on client-specific KPIs up front: revenue growth, conversion rate, engagement, lead generation, brand reach and return on investment.

items.q: Can you customize your services for my business?
items.a: Absolutely. We tailor our services to fit your unique needs, industry and growth goals rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all package.

items.q: What if I need ongoing support?
items.a: We offer continuous support packages that include monitoring, optimization, security updates and regular performance reviews.

about.storyTitle: IT solutions with years of experience.
about.story: Oluseed Technologies Limited (RC 1664920) is a technology company that started in 2016 as a full robotics company and was registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission on 5 March 2020. Today we deliver website and app design, software applications, data science, cybersecurity, digital marketing, robotics, embedded systems, project management, start-up services and general ICT services, maintaining efficiency in our operations while focusing on solving ICT problems globally.

posts.title: Understanding React Hooks
posts.subtitle: A deep dive into the world of React Hooks and how they can simplify your code.
posts.description: React Hooks are functions that let you use state and other React features without writing a class. They were introduced in React 16.8 and have since become a fundamental part of React development. In this post we explore the most commonly used hooks, including useState, useEffect and useContext, with examples of how to use them effectively in your applications.
